Jordan Meyers: Quick status check — acmecorp onprem rollout is slated for next week (Wed-Thu). Need final owners for NAT/proxy, cert sync plan for airgapped images, and a CR review for the infra changes. Who can take NAT/proxy ownership?
Elaine Park: I can take NAT/proxy. Will validate firewall rules and layering with the proxy. ETA EOD Tue.
Mike Chen: I'll own airgap image sync + cert rotation. Need the list of allowed egress IPs (if any) or confirmation we'll use mirror/seed method.
Sophie Laurent: @Mike will DM the IPs for staging/prod. They differ; staging uses the internal mirror.
Jordan Meyers: CR is opened: https://git.internal/r/infra/edge-prov — reviewers: eng-sre + security. Please ping when done, want to lock config by Monday.
Alex Rios: Reviewing now, small thing on `iptables` ordering that could break conntrack on failover. Posting suggested snippet.
Alex Rios: ```
# drop invalid first, then established
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -i eth0 -o eth1 -j ACCEPT
```
Elaine Park: Confirmed Alex's ordering. I'll stage the rule on canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. @InfraBot can you schedule a canary deploy at that time? :thumbsup: 
InfraBot: Canary deploy scheduled to cluster `prod-canary` at 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z per request of Elaine Park. JobID: job-0x8f12. Status: queued.
Carla Singh: Quick security question — for the airgap image sync, do we need outbound HTTPS to `images.redwood.ai`, or will ops provide a mirror seed? Security wants explicit confirmation.
Mike Chen: We'll use a customer-seeded mirror. Ops will `rsync` images to the jumpbox over SSH; no outbound from customer network required. I'll add the runbook steps and verify checksums.
Jordan Meyers: Perfect. One more: who's primary oncall for 48h post-cutover? @Sophie?
Sophie Laurent: I can be primary for the first 24h, Mike will be secondary. I'll create the PD rotation entry and add escalation docs.
Jordan Meyers: Thanks — I'll update the rollout doc and mark NAT/proxy = Elaine, airgap = Mike, oncall = Sophie/Mike. Please post any CR approvals in this thread so I can close the ticket.
Elaine Park: Will post CR approval after smoke on canary.
Alex Rios: Approved with one minor comment addressed.
InfraBot: Reminder: security scan scheduled for 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z on the infra branch.
Jordan Meyers: Awesome, closing loop — if anyone finds new blockers drop them here, otherwise we proceed to canary as scheduled. :white_check_mark:
